periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The long axis of each teardrop-shaped patch is oriented at approximately a 45-degree angle, converging toward the midline of the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovoid geometry with a vertical-to-horizontal elongation ratio of approximately 1.5:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward and inward tapering where the patch boundary extends toward the muzzle.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: The posterior margin of the dark band exhibits a shallow, broad U-shaped curvature across the dorsal surface.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness, occupying approximately 40% of the visible dorsal torso area.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation between the medial bases of the ears, approximately 1.5 times the width of a single ear region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, convex semicircular curvature at the superior apex of the pinnae.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent reddish-pink pigmentation/staining visible on the white fur of the forehead, crown, and upper dorsal region.
